about: What may leave this repository for a real system, by object. tools/osd-abapgit-zip.mjs refuses any object that is not listed in the unit it builds, and any object with an SAP-owned name even when it is listed, unless the entry says why it is intended. See docs/a4h-deploy.md, section 'What may leave for a system'.

l3demo.description: The DSL L3 fleet set and its ABAP Unit proof (docs/dsl-l3.md, Proof): the four L2 tables and their data element, the six enabled rule classes, the runner with its ports (two interfaces, five generated variants, the factory and its exception), its job report, the alert log, the pile plan table, the run lock and the proof class; and the two-stage set ZCL_L3_FLEET2 (slice 3b): the keys rule ZCL_L2_SHIP_BUSY, its runner, report, ports (with the worklist variant), the worklist ZOSD_L3_WORK and the stage gate ZOSD_L3_STAGE; and since slice 5a the doctor's audit ZOSD_L3_DOCTOR and the kill switch ZOSD_L3_KILL. Staged into one flat folder from src/l2demo, src/dsl and src/l3proof.

lift-r3-probe.description: Disposable R3 ABAP/Open SQL comparison probe; the unit owns its synthetic table and class.

demo.description: The demo SEGW service and its DDIC, as the numbered A4H attempts carried it (docs/a4h-deploy.md, levels 002-007).

demo-app.description: The demo's Fiori app as a BSP application and its ICF node, built by tools/osd-bsp-app.mjs (level 008).

lsd-a4h-011.description: The LSD light show as installed in $ZOSD_011 (deploy/lsd-a4h-011/README.md).

zvdb.description: The ZVDB 100 vector-search pack, its service, workbench and the two buckets (packs/zvdb/README.md).
